knowledge.name: Synthetic title rights snapshot
knowledge.detail: Five fictional titles with territory, platform, requested launch, contract, clause text, and status.

knowledge.name: Distribution window records
knowledge.detail: Per-title window type, opening, run length, holdback, restriction, and earliest launch date.

knowledge.name: Approval readiness records
knowledge.detail: Per-title missing items, rights approval status, rights reviewer, and next step.

knowledge.name: Rights rules and guardrails
knowledge.detail: Routing, clause-citation, evidence, and no-scheduling rules bundled as a knowledge file.

intelligence_processing.name: Clause-cited clearance check
intelligence_processing.detail: States whether a title is cleared in its territory on the owned streaming service and quotes the clause.

intelligence_processing.name: Window and holdback reading
intelligence_processing.detail: Reports when the rights window opens, which holdback applies, and the earliest open launch date.

intelligence_processing.name: Approval readiness evaluation
intelligence_processing.detail: Marks a request ready only when nothing is missing and the contract status is approved.

intelligence_processing.name: Approval request drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Assembles title, territory, clearance, contract clause, and next step into a request that is never submitted.

intelligence_processing.name: Fail-closed title resolution
intelligence_processing.detail: Resolves a title by key or name, defaults to the demo title, and never substitutes an unknown title.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio rights experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the pilot with three skills and two synthetic knowledge files; the package stays Draft until review.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file ContentLaunchClearanceAgent locally with deterministic title routing.

management_reporting.name: Launch clearance answer
management_reporting.detail: Territory, platform, requested launch, clearance, cited contract clause, and the scheduling restriction.

management_reporting.name: Distribution window table
management_reporting.detail: Window, opening, run length, holdback, and earliest launch with the source contract and clause.

management_reporting.name: Approval request draft
management_reporting.detail: Rights status, reviewer, readiness, missing items, and next step; no approval is submitted.

management_reporting.name: Rights acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Three locked programming, distribution, and rights lead cases, one per operation.

tools.name: Portable ContentLaunchClearanceAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with three deterministic read-only operations over synthetic rights.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the three-skill package; publishing needs an authorized reviewer.

tools.name: Rights contracts in Microsoft SharePoint
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for approved rights contracts; no live connection in the package.

tools.name: Distribution window and holdback records
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for windows and holdbacks; synthetic records stand in.

tools.name: Power Automate approvals
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for rights approval status; the agent never submits or grants an approval.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic rights evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every title, territory, contract, clause, window, holdback, and reviewer is invented; no browsing.

supporting_features.name: No scheduling or contract changes
supporting_features.detail: Never schedules, publishes, or withdraws a title, changes a contract, or contacts a licensor.

supporting_features.name: Rights team approval gate
supporting_features.detail: Programming, distribution, and the rights and clearances team keep every launch decision.

supporting_features.name: Exact clause citation
supporting_features.detail: Every clearance answer names the contract document and clause and keeps figures as returned.

supporting_features.name: Controlled future writes
supporting_features.detail: Any later write needs authenticated tools, authorization checks, explicit human approval, and an audit log.
